evidence.fact: The 2026 TOUR Championship is scheduled to take place at East Lake Golf Club in Atlanta, Georgia, from August 27 to August 30, 2026, serving as the final event of the FedExCup Playoffs.
The total purse for the 2026 TOUR Championship at East Lake Golf Club is established at $40,000,000.
Tommy Fleetwood won the 2025 TOUR Championship at East Lake Golf Club with a 72-hole total score of 262 (-18), earning the top prize of $10,000,000.
Scottie Scheffler captured the 2024 TOUR Championship title at East Lake Golf Club with a 72-hole winning score of 264 (-30).
Viktor Hovland won the 2022-2023 TOUR Championship at East Lake Golf Club with a 72-hole aggregate score of 261 (-27).
The 2026 FedExCup Playoffs comprise three consecutive events beginning with the FedEx St. Jude Championship at TPC Southwind from August 13-16.
The second leg of the 2026 FedExCup Playoffs is the BMW Championship, scheduled at Bellerive Country Club from August 20-23, restricting its starting field to the top 50 in the FedExCup standings.
The top 30 players in the final FedExCup points list following the BMW Championship advance as the exclusive field to compete in the 2026 TOUR Championship at East Lake.
Rory McIlroy secured the 2021-2022 TOUR Championship title at East Lake Golf Club with a 72-hole total score of 263 (-21).
Patrick Cantlay won the 2020-2021 TOUR Championship at East Lake Golf Club with a 72-hole total score of 269 (-21).
The top 70 players in the PGA Tour FedExCup standings qualify to tee off at the opening playoff event, the FedEx St. Jude Championship.
Dustin Johnson claimed victory at the 2019-2020 TOUR Championship at East Lake Golf Club posting a 72-hole aggregate score of 269 (-21).
